topics.title: Pause and resume
topics.text:
Press Space, or click Pause, to stop the log while you read it. A banner marks the pause and counts the events that arrived meanwhile: they are not shown, but the statistics and the saved logs keep counting them.

Space again, or Resume, carries on with the newest events.

topics.title: Show only some features
topics.text:
Features lists every kind of event the camera has sent. Switch one off to hide its events; right-click a name to show only that one; Select all brings them all back.

The log is redrawn at once, earlier events included.

topics.title: Filter by state and rule
topics.text:
True or False shows only the events in that state; All shows both. Rule shows the events of one rule (the name it has on the camera).

Reset filters clears every filter, the features included.

topics.title: Event statistics
topics.text:
Show event statistics opens a table: for each feature, how many true and false events came, its last state and how long ago. It counts every event of this connection, also while the log is paused or filtered. The connected camera's row shows how long it has been connected.

Show details splits a feature by its sub-items (Enter / Exit); Show average turns the counts into rates per second, minute or hour, over the whole session or its last 10 seconds to 1 minute; Follow feature filter keeps the table to the features shown in the log.

topics.title: Copy an event's metadata
topics.text:
Double-click an event's timestamp: its metadata, exactly as the camera sent it, goes to the clipboard, ready to paste into a bug report or an editor.

Possible for 5 minutes after the event arrived.

topics.title: Read an event's metadata
topics.text:
Double-click the feature name: a panel shows the event's metadata, colour-coded, and a picture of the panel goes to the clipboard.

It closes by itself after a while, or with a click or Esc (Settings > General: how long, and its colours).

topics.title: App memory and RTP loss
topics.text:
App memory, under the camera list, is the memory this app uses (as Task Manager shows it), measured once a minute. Point at the curve to read a minute.

It should stay about level however long the app runs: a line that keeps climbing for hours is a memory leak. Please report it (Help > Home page, feedback) with logs\debug.log.

RTP loss, on the bottom bar, is the share of the camera's packets that never arrived: green under 1%, then yellow, orange and red. Lost packets are lost events: check the network and the camera.
